records.label: spacr.attribution#10
records.source: **Two head shapes, one contract.** A spaCR classifier's head emits either one logit (binary; class 1 when the logit is positive) or ``C`` logits. Code that assumes one shape is wrong for the other, and silently so: attributing the raw logit of a single-logit head always explains *class 1*, so for an image the model called class 0 the map you get is the map for the class it rejected — the negation of what you asked for. Every method here goes through :class:`ClassScoreModel`, which presents a single logit ``z`` as the two-column view ``[-z, +z]``. Both classes then have a real gradient, ``target`` means the same thing for both head shapes, and no caller has to know which head it has.

Code that assumes one shape is wrong for the other, and silently so: attributing the raw logit of a single-logit head always explains *class 1*, so for an image the model called class 0 the map you get is the map for the class it rejected — the negation of what you asked for. Every method here goes through :class:`ClassScoreModel`, which presents a single logit ``z`` as the two-column view ``[-z, +z]``. Both classes then have a real gradient, ``target`` means the same thing for both head shapes, and no caller has to know which head it has.
records.translation: **Tvö höfuðsnið, einn samningur.** Höfuð flokkara í spaCR gefur annaðhvort eitt logit (tvíundar; flokkur 1 þegar logitið er jákvætt) eða ``C`` logit. Kóði sem gerir ráð fyrir öðru sniðinu er rangur fyrir hitt, og það án þess að nokkur taki eftir því: að úthluta hráu logiti höfuðs með einu logiti útskýrir alltaf *flokk 1*, svo fyrir mynd sem líkanið flokkaði sem flokk 0 er kortið sem fæst kortið fyrir flokkinn sem það hafnaði — andstæða þess sem beðið var um. Allar aðferðir hér fara í gegnum :class:`ClassScoreModel`, sem birtir eitt logit ``z`` sem tveggja dálka sýnina ``[-z, +z]``. Báðir flokkar fá þá raunverulegan stigul, ``target`` þýðir það sama fyrir bæði höfuðsniðin og enginn kallari þarf að vita hvaða höfuð hann er með.

records.label: spacr.ops_merge#1
records.source: Optical pooled screening images the same well twice: once at low magnification to read the barcodes, once at high magnification to measure the phenotype. Every cell must be matched between the two, and the obvious method -- correlate the images -- does not work. The pixels do not correspond: the scale differs, the stains differ, and often the microscope differs too.

The pixels do not correspond: the scale differs, the stains differ, and often the microscope differs too.
records.translation: Sjónræn samsett skimun (optical pooled screening) myndar sama brunn tvisvar: einu sinni í lítilli stækkun til að lesa strikamerkin, einu sinni í mikilli stækkun til að mæla svipgerðina. Hver fruma verður að vera pöruð á milli, og augljósa aðferðin -- að fylgnireikna myndirnar -- virkar ekki. Mynddílarnir samsvara ekki: kvarðinn er ólíkur, litanirnar eru ólíkar og oft er smásjáin líka ólík.

records.label: spacr.ops_merge#2
records.source: What is preserved is the arrangement of the cells. Take three neighbouring cells and the shape of the triangle they form is unchanged by magnification, rotation and translation. So the cells are triangulated, each triangle is reduced to a descriptor that depends only on its shape, and the two sets are matched on those descriptors. The transform between the acquisitions falls out of the matched triangles, and the cells are paired under it.

records.translation: Það sem varðveitist er uppröðun frumnanna. Taktu þrjár nágrannafrumur og lögun þríhyrningsins sem þær mynda breytist ekki við stækkun, snúning og hliðrun. Því eru frumurnar þríhyrningsskiptar, hver þríhyrningur er felldur niður í lýsi sem veltur aðeins á lögun hans og mengin tvö eru pöruð á þessum lýsum. Umbreytingin milli öflunanna leiðir af pöruðu þríhyrningunum og frumurnar eru paraðar með henni.

A wrongly matched cell gives a real phenotype the wrong barcode, which silently corrupts a screen; a dropped one costs only statistical power, which more cells can buy back.

records.label: spacr.qt.bridge.RunRegistry.cancel_all#2
records.source: Read-only UI housekeeping (``journal=False`` — a history refresh, a model scan) is cancelled and waited for exactly like everything else, but it never appears in the return value. It writes nothing, so there is no half-written artefact to protect, and a caller that treats it as a veto turns "the run-history list is still loading" into "the application cannot be closed". ``MainWindow.closeEvent`` answers a non-empty return by refusing to close *and showing a modal*: on a headless run — CI, a test shard — nothing can ever dismiss that modal, and the process spins in its nested event loop with no forward progress. A housekeeping job that outlived the screen which started it used to be enough to trigger it.

A housekeeping job that outlived the screen which started it used to be enough to trigger it.
records.translation: Hreingerningarverk UI sem eingöngu les (``journal=False`` — endurnýjun ferils, líkanaskönnun) eru felld niður og beðið eftir þeim nákvæmlega eins og öllu öðru, en birtast aldrei í skilagildinu. Þau skrifa ekkert, svo ekkert hálfskrifað afurð er til að vernda, og kallari sem meðhöndlar þau sem neitunarvald breytir "keyrsluferillinn er enn að hlaðast" í "ekki er hægt að loka forritinu". ``MainWindow.closeEvent`` svarar ekki-tómu skilagildi með því að neita að loka *og sýna mótaðan glugga*: í keyrslu án skjás — CI, prófunarbrot — getur ekkert nokkru sinni lokað þeim glugga, og ferlið snýst í nestaðri atburðalykkju sinni án framvindu. Hreingerningarverk sem lifði lengur en skjárinn sem ræsti það nægði áður til að valda því.

records.source: A widget's QSS font is resolved when it is polished, which for a screen built into a stacked page happens on the way to the first show. Measuring here as well as on the font change is what keeps a row that was never sent a font change -- because its own font was inherited whole -- from being sized by the default metrics.
records.context: A widget's QSS font is resolved when it is polished, which for an application view built into a stacked page happens on the way to the first show. Measuring here as well as on the font change is what keeps a row that was never sent a font change -- because its own font was inherited whole -- from being sized by the default metrics.
records.translation: QSS-letur græju er leyst þegar hún er pússuð, sem fyrir skjá í staflaðri síðu gerist á leiðinni í fyrstu birtingu. Að mæla hér, auk þess að mæla við leturbreytingu, kemur í veg fyrir að röð sem aldrei fékk leturbreytingu -- því eigið letur hennar var erft í heild -- sé stærðarákvörðuð með sjálfgefnum mælikvörðum.

records.label: spacr.restart_state#1
records.source: The restart record stores the current module, its settings, a summary of active runs, and the locations of any run folders. :func:`save` verifies the record before the current process exits, and :func:`take` consumes it when the new process starts so that stale state is not restored repeatedly.
records.context: The restart record stores the current module, its settings, a summary of active runs, and the locations of any processing-session folders. :func:`save` verifies the record before the current process exits, and :func:`take` consumes it when the new process starts so that stale state is not restored repeatedly.
records.translation: Endurræsiskráin geymir núverandi einingu, stillingar hennar, samantekt á virkum keyrslum og staðsetningar allra keyrslumappa. :func:`save` staðfestir skrána áður en núverandi ferli lýkur og :func:`take` eyðir henni þegar nýja ferlið ræsist, svo úrelt ástand sé ekki endurheimt aftur og aftur.

records.label: spacr.restart_state#2
records.source: Only the interface configuration is restored. Active computations do not resume after a forced restart; output written before the restart remains in the recorded run folders.
records.context: Only the interface configuration is restored. Active computations do not resume after a forced restart; output written before the restart remains in the recorded processing-session folders.
records.translation: Aðeins viðmótsstillingarnar eru endurheimtar. Virkir útreikningar halda ekki áfram eftir þvingaða endurræsingu; úttak sem skrifað var fyrir endurræsinguna er áfram í skráðu keyrslumöppunum.
